_note: Intentionally EMPTY. Every entry is a reviewed commit that cites the offline eval report digest, the thresholds it met, the approver and the date. Until an entry exists for a (feature, prompt_version, vendor, model, effort, app_env) tuple, that VENDOR is skipped in AI_PROVIDER_TIER in that DEPLOYED environment; when no vendor in the tier has one, requests are refused with configuration_not_approved. Local and test environments are unaffected. One entry per (feature, vendor) is required before failover has more than one live tier: the vendor joined the key with D-053 because the review is per vendor - the grounding validator has to be proven against THAT vendor's structured-output shape, its terms have to permit the data, and the Anthropic-only request features (prompt caching, the server-side fallback beta, adaptive thinking) are absent there. Adding an entry is the last step of the production gate described in .ai/icaap/agent-reports/P4.md, after the data-protection opinion, the provider terms, the tenant consent text and the eval sign-off.
